name: Ahmed Bey Palace

Original blue/cream/ochre tile bands and representative unlettered painted panels. Courtyard sizes/bay counts come from original1867text, placement within boundary is explicitly inferred, not a surveyed floorplan. Exclude mosque/neighbors/publicplaza/naturalground/trees/gardenvegetation/exhibits/people/furnishings/interiors and copied lettering.
